name: narrow_integer_schema
sql: select cast(-128 as tinyint) as a, cast(32767 as smallint) as b, cast(-2147483648 as integer) as c

name: scalar_parameter_families
sql: select cast($1 as varchar) as u, cast($2 as double) as f, cast($3 as boolean) as b, encode($4, 'hex') as bytes

name: unicode_placeholder_locations
sql:
select '雪?' as literal, cast(? as bigint) as a, -- ? ignored
 cast(? as bigint) as b /* Ω ? */
native_sql:
select '雪?' as literal, cast($1 as bigint) as a, -- ? ignored
 cast($2 as bigint) as b /* Ω ? */

name: join_and_null_filter
sql: select a.id, b.label from (values (1), (2), (3)) as a(id) left join (values (1, 'one'), (3, 'three')) as b(id, label) on a.id = b.id order by a.id
